title: Recent Changes in International Asthma Guidelines May Be Influenced by Pharmaceutical Industry Conflicts of Interest
authorConflicts: Author disclosure: no relevant financial relationships.
result: Editorial. States that 12 of 17 members of the GINA Board of Directors and Science Committee, including both chairs, had received personal fees from AstraZeneca (GINA 2021 disclosures), that the US NAEPP panel had fewer such conflicts and recused conflicted members, and that GINA does not follow the National Academy of Medicine recommendation that conflicted members be a minority and that chairs be free of conflicts. Notes that budesonide/formoterol (Symbicort) is marketed by AstraZeneca, with more than 2.5 billion US dollars of worldwide sales in 2021; that four of the studies in the 2021 Cochrane review of as-needed combination inhalers were funded by AstraZeneca; and that 14 of 15 trials in a 2018 systematic review of maintenance and reliever therapy were funded by AstraZeneca, had an AstraZeneca employee as co-author or had authors paid by AstraZeneca.
